question: P starts from A at 6 a.m. and reaches B after 8 hours. Q starts from B of 8 a.m. and reaches A after 9 hour. When they meet, what is the ratio of the distance travelled by Q to the distance travelled by P?
solution: Given: P starts from A at 6 a.m. and reaches B after 8 hours. Q starts from B at 8 a.m. and reaches A after 9 hours. Concept used: 1. Time taken to meet for two objects coming towards each other = Intermediary distance ÷ Relative speed 2. Distance = Speed × Time Calculation: Let the distance between A and B be 72w km. Speed of P = 72w/8 = 9w km/h Speed of Q = 72w/9 = 8w km/h
